summary: Iteration 2 (Report Builder) tested end-to-end. 33/33 backend pytest tests pass (catalog, 10 prebuilt reports x PDF+CSV = 20, column shape checks, throughput row count, 404/400 errors, custom builder CSV/PDF, bad group_by, kev filter, date filter, plus legacy /reports/csv/findings + /reports/pdf/executive regression). Frontend /reports page renders all 10 cards with PDF+CSV buttons (data-testid=report-<id>, dl-<id>-pdf, dl-<id>-csv) and the Dynamic Report Builder section with every documented testid (b-metric, b-group, b-fmt-pdf/csv, b-sev-Critical..Info, b-status, b-kev, b-internet, b-team, b-product, b-env, b-datefield, b-datefrom, b-dateto, b-run). End-to-end builder flow as admin (metric=risk_sum, group_by=owner_team, sev=Critical) downloaded custom-report.csv and custom-report.pdf with success toast. Legacy Findings page Export CSV button still downloads findings.csv.
critical_code_review_comments: reports.py run_custom() builds filters[date_field] via setdefault but does not pre-strip non-date filters that may collide with the same key; ok in practice since date_field values are always *_at fields.

reports.py 'overdue_critical' filename produces overdue-critical-high.{csv,pdf} but Reports.jsx downloads it as overdue_critical.{csv,pdf} (uses report_id, not server-suggested filename). Cosmetic only — file still saves; consider honoring Content-Disposition for cleaner UX.
Reports.jsx: when user clicks b-sev chip but never picks status, the multi-select <select multiple> is a non-shadcn native widget — works but visually inconsistent with the rest of the dark UI.
server.py /v1/reports/run-custom: no allow-list for filters keys; raw filter map silently drops unknown keys (safe) but consider rejecting unknown keys to surface client errors.
Catalog endpoint hard-codes filter_fields/metrics/date_fields in server.py instead of reading from reports.py — minor DRY violation if list ever drifts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 of 3 complete. All report endpoints + UI verified. Iteration 3 will add more features; rerun /app/backend/tests/test_reports_iter2.py to confirm no regressions to the Report Builder.
